wargear.name: Bile-stained banner
wargear.summary: A banner so thick with dried filth that the wind cannot lift it, carried by men who no longer notice the stink.
wargear.text: While a Unit includes a Model equipped with a Bile-stained banner, all Models in that Unit have the Feel No Pain (6+) Special Rule. If the Model carrying the banner is removed as a casualty, the bonus is lost.

wargear.name: Choking cloud canisters
wargear.summary: Canisters of sour vapour cracked open as the squad closes.
wargear.text: While a Unit includes a Model equipped with Choking cloud canisters, all Models in that Unit have the Fear (1) Special Rule. If the Model carrying the canisters is removed as a casualty, the bonus is lost.

wargear.name: Bloated sarcophagus
wargear.summary: The occupant has been dead for years and the machine has kept him going on rot.
wargear.text: A Walker equipped with a Bloated sarcophagus has the Feel No Pain (6+) Special Rule.

wargear.name: Blight-grenade bandolier
wargear.text: While a Unit includes a Model equipped with a Blight-grenade bandolier, all Models in that Unit have the Blightbomb Salvo Special Rule. If the Model carrying the bandolier is removed as a casualty, the bonus is lost.

wargear.name: Reeking censer
wargear.summary: A swinging censer trailing a thick, buzzing cloud.
wargear.text: A Model equipped with a Reeking censer has the Dirge of Flies Special Rule.

wargear.name: Tolling bell
wargear.summary: A cracked bell rung for every brother who falls.
wargear.text: A Model equipped with a Tolling bell has the Death Knell Special Rule.

wargear.name: Scab-plate carapace
wargear.summary: Layers of crusted plate grown over the armour.
wargear.text: A Model equipped with a Scab-plate carapace has the Scabbed Carapace Special Rule.

wargear.name: Choking exhaust vents
wargear.summary: Engine vents that trail a cloud of corrosive spores.
wargear.text: A Vehicle equipped with Choking exhaust vents has the Choking Wake Special Rule.

wargear.name: Rot-fed spirit core
wargear.summary: A machine spirit that has learned to rot slowly.
wargear.text: A Vehicle equipped with a Rot-fed spirit core has the Unquiet Spirit Special Rule.

wargear.name: Rust-plough
wargear.summary: A corroded plough blade fitted to the prow.
wargear.text: A Vehicle equipped with a Rust-plough has the Rust-Plough Special Rule.

wargear.name: Pall-veil of Barbarus
wargear.summary: A shroud of the grey poison-fog of his home world, which rises to hide him.
wargear.text: A Model equipped with the Pall-veil of Barbarus has the Shrouded (5+) Special Rule.

wargear.name: Reaper's tally-chain
wargear.summary: A heavy chain strung with a skull for every host he has cut down.
wargear.text: A Model equipped with the Reaper's tally-chain has the Tally of the Reaped Special Rule.

modifiers.condition: while Locked in Combat with a Unit of 5 or more Models

rules.name: Inexorable
rules.summary: They have stopped feeling the cost of the march.
rules.text: A Unit with this Special Rule ignores the effects of the Suppressed Tactical Status.

rules.name: Walking Dead
rules.summary: The dead keep walking, and the walking dead are hard to kill.
rules.text: When a Model with this Special Rule is removed as a casualty in the Fight Sub-Phase, roll a Dice: on a 5+ it may make one Melee Attack before it is removed. If its Unit did not move during its Controlling Player's most recent Movement phase, it also has the Feel No Pain (5+) Special Rule until the start of its next Movement phase.

rules.name: Miasma of Contagion
rules.summary: The air around them is a sickness all its own.
rules.text: When a Unit with this Special Rule charges an enemy Unit, or is charged by one, the Models of the enemy Unit subtract 1 from their Weapon Skill Characteristic for the first round of that Assault.

rules.name: Sworn Guard
rules.summary: They stand where the Reaper stands and do not die before he does.
rules.text: A Unit with this Special Rule has the Feel No Pain (5+) Special Rule while it is within 6" of Mortarion or Calas Typhon.

rules.name: Blightbomb Salvo
rules.summary: A handful of rotted canisters, thrown without a second thought.
rules.text: Once per battle, in the Shooting phase, a Unit with this Special Rule may throw blight at one enemy Unit within 8". The enemy Unit suffers one automatic hit for each Model in the throwing Unit (to a maximum of 5), each with the Poisoned (4+) Special Rule, no AP and a Damage of 1.

rules.name: Dirge of Flies
rules.summary: The buzzing cloud hides the bearer from every eye.
rules.text: While an enemy Unit is within 6" of a Model with this Special Rule, it cannot make Reaction Shooting Attacks against that Model or its Unit.

rules.name: Death Knell
rules.summary: The bell tolls for every brother who falls.
rules.text: Each time a friendly Death Guard Unit within 6" of a Model with this Special Rule is destroyed, each enemy Unit within 12" of that Model subtracts 1 from its Cool Characteristic until the end of that Battle Turn.

rules.name: Scabbed Carapace
rules.summary: The crust thickens over every wound, until blades skate off it.
rules.text: The AP of any attack made against a Model with this Special Rule is treated as having no AP if it is 4 or worse.

rules.name: Choking Wake
rules.summary: Whatever the hull passes through, it leaves coughing.
rules.text: After a Vehicle with this Special Rule moves, each enemy Unit it moved within 3" of suffers one automatic hit with the Poisoned (4+) Special Rule, no AP and a Damage of 1.

rules.name: Unquiet Spirit
rules.summary: The spirit has rotted slowly enough to keep fighting.
rules.text: Once per battle, when a Vehicle with this Special Rule would be Stunned or Shaken, it ignores that result.

rules.name: Rust-Plough
rules.summary: The blade tears through wire, rubble and flesh alike.
rules.text: A Vehicle with this Special Rule does not make Dangerous Terrain Tests. Each enemy Unit that it Rams subtracts 1 from its Initiative Characteristic until the end of that Battle Turn.

rules.name: Reaper of Barbarus
rules.summary: He was raised on a world that killed the slow, and he fights as its hunters did.
rules.text: In a Battle Turn in which this Model made a successful Charge, each enemy Model that is Locked in Combat with it subtracts 1 from its Initiative Characteristic until the end of that Fight Sub-Phase. This Model subtracts 1 from its Toughness Characteristic.

rules.name: Plaguewind Sovereign
rules.summary: The poison he carries is no longer content to wait for his enemies to come close.
rules.text: At the start of the Fight Sub-Phase, after the Death Cloud has been resolved, each enemy Unit that is Locked in Combat with this Model suffers one additional Hit. This Hit has a Strength of 3, the Poisoned (3+) Special Rule, an AP of 4 and a Damage Characteristic of 1, and no Cover Saves or Shrouded Damage Mitigation Tests may be made against it. This Model subtracts 2 from its Movement Characteristic and 1 from its Initiative Characteristic.

rules.name: Unmoving Mourner
rules.summary: He plants his feet, and the field must come to him.
rules.text: This Model has the Feel No Pain (5+) Special Rule. It subtracts 1 from its Attacks Characteristic and 1 from its Weapon Skill Characteristic.

rules.name: Tally of the Reaped
rules.summary: Every skull on the chain is a crowd he cut through, and he is never content with fewer.
rules.text: While this Model is Locked in Combat with an enemy Unit that includes five or more Models, it adds 1 to its Attacks Characteristic.

rites.name: Unhurried Death
rites.flavor: The Legion has never run, and it has never needed to.
benefits: Every Death Guard Infantry Unit gains Inexorable: it ignores the effects of the Suppressed Tactical Status.
Every Death Guard Infantry Unit except the Praevian (who already has Feel No Pain (5+)) gains Feel No Pain (6+).
limitations: Every Death Guard Infantry Unit subtracts 1 from its Move Characteristic.
No Fast Attack units and no model with the Antigrav type.

rites.name: The Walking Dead March
rites.flavor: No tracks. No wings. Only the long walk, and the guns that come with it.
benefits: Grave Warden Terminator Squads may fill Troops slots and gain Line (1).
They gain Walking Dead: a Model slain in the Fight Sub-Phase strikes once more on a 5+, and Feel No Pain (5+) in any turn they did not move.
limitations: At least one Grave Warden Terminator Squad is required.
No Transport or Heavy Transport units.
No unit may start the battle in Reserve: the whole army deploys on the table.

modifiers.text: The Walking Dead March: Line (1), Walking Dead.

require.note: Bring at least one Grave Warden Terminator Squad.

rites.name: Doctrine of Contagion
rites.flavor: A battle is won when the other side is too sick to hold the line.
benefits: Mortus Poisoner Squads may fill Troops slots and gain Fear (1).
They gain Miasma of Contagion: enemy Units that charge them, or that they charge, subtract 1 from their Weapon Skill Characteristic in the first round of that Assault.
limitations: At least two Mortus Poisoner Squads are required.
No Apothecaries and no Primus Medicae.

modifiers.text: Doctrine of Contagion: Fear (1), Miasma of Contagion.

require.note: Bring at least two Mortus Poisoner Squads.

rites.name: The Reaper's Honour Guard
rites.flavor: Where the Primarch walks, the Deathshroud walk a pace behind, and nothing else is permitted near.
benefits: Deathshroud Terminator Squads may fill Troops slots and gain Line (1).
They gain Sworn Guard: Feel No Pain (5+) while within 6" of Mortarion or Calas Typhon.
limitations: The army must be led by Mortarion or Calas Typhon.
At least two Deathshroud Squads are required.
No Recon units, and no Heavy Assault units other than Grave Warden squads.

modifiers.text: The Reaper's Honour Guard: Line (1), Sworn Guard.

require.note: Mortarion or Calas Typhon must lead the army.
Bring at least two Deathshroud Squads.

armyRules.name: Death's Slow Tread
armyRules.flavor: They do not flinch, and they do not hurry.
benefits: A Unit with this Special Rule ignores the effects of the Pinning (X) and Suppressive (X) Special Rules.
drawbacks: A Unit with this Special Rule cannot Rush, and its Reaction Shooting Attacks are made with a -1 modifier to Hit Tests.

armyRules.name: Withering Blight
armyRules.flavor: Their wounds fester in the flesh.
benefits: When a Model is wounded but not removed as a casualty by an attack made by a Unit with this Special Rule, it subtracts 1 from its Toughness Characteristic until the end of that Battle Turn.
drawbacks: Hit Tests made for Shooting Attacks by a Unit with this Special Rule against targets more than 18" away are made with a -1 modifier.

armyRules.name: Pestilential Aura
armyRules.flavor: A cloud of rot rolls from the captains of the Legion.
benefits: At the start of each Assault phase, each enemy Unit in base contact with a Model with this Special Rule suffers one automatic hit with the Poisoned (4+) Special Rule, no AP and a Damage of 1.
drawbacks: A Unit that includes a Model with this Special Rule cannot benefit from the Medic (X) Special Rule.

armyRules.name: The Long Grey March
armyRules.flavor: The Legion is slow, but it cannot be turned, and it does not break while its Primarch walks at the front.
benefits: While Mortarion is on the battlefield, each friendly Death Guard Infantry Model within 12" of him counts as two Models when determining control of an Objective.
drawbacks: If Mortarion is removed as a casualty, every friendly Death Guard Model subtracts 1 from its Cool Characteristic for the remainder of the Battle.
armyRules.condition: within 12" of Mortarion: counts as two Models for Objectives
